# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #35 and everything under it audited, so that "Advanced Services: AI Service & Media Service" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #35 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Advanced Services: AI Service & Media Service" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given epic #35, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are complete and correct (rewrote the epic's stale "hasn't been started yet" line and its Notes, which named only 3 of 4 child stories; sub-issue links are #93, #94, #95, #115, all closed, matching `sub_issues_summary`)
- [x] Given story #93 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#277)
- [x] Given story #94 and its 1 task, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#278)
- [x] Given story #95 and its 1 task, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#279)
- [x] Given story #115 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#280)
- [x] Given every criterion in this subtree, when it is read, then it names a test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date (checked #35, #93, #94, #95, #115, #36, #48, #68, #37, #38, #116, #117 by hand against the `audit-check.py` rules — `gh` is unavailable in this sandbox, so the script itself could not run; no dated criterion and no criterion without a named proof)
- [x] Given every issue in this subtree, when its metadata is read, then it has one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct native parent link (same 12 issues, checked by hand: one type + one priority label each, no `sprint-N`, native parent link present and correct on every non-epic)
- [x] Given every child story is audited, when epic #35 is checked, then it is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise (epic #35 closed 2026-08-04; all 4 stories closed)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

**Estimate:** 5

## Definition of Done

## Notes
Scope: epic #35, its 4 stories, and the 7 tasks under them.

`gh` is not available in this run's sandbox, so the whole-subtree `audit-check.py --tree` pass was done as an equivalent manual check against the same rules (one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N`, native parent link, no banned sections, no dated criteria, every criterion names a proof, no closed issue with an open child or unchecked box) instead of running the script.
